document.title: perf: swap the instance tree only when dirty, cache the package list, drop per-frame allocations
document.summary: Four independent performance fixes: the JS thread swaps the instance tree only after a mutation and sleeps when idle, the Installed Deck App Library caches its package list, input hit tests copy ids into fixed buffers, and the reconciler skips native updates when no prop changed by value.
document.why: The JS thread busy-loops a full tree copy and the Shell re-parses manifests every frame ([#54](source:s1)); the hit test also allocates a copy of the hit id every frame ([Máté's note](source:s2)).

sources.title: Performance: JS thread busy-loops a full tree copy; shell re-parses manifests every frame
sources.gist: Dirty flag for the swap, cache the package list, use or drop the prepareUpdate payload.

sources.label: #54 comment
sources.gist: Replace the per-frame strdup in instance_hit_test with a caller-provided fixed buffer.

parts.name: Idle JS thread
parts.summary: Native mutations mark the back buffer dirty, the swap is skipped otherwise, and the loop sleeps until the next timer, capped at 4 ms.

parts.name: Package list cache
parts.summary: package_library.c caches the scanned list under its mutex and bootstrap parses the active manifest once for fonts and images.

parts.name: Allocation-free input
parts.summary: Hit test and scroll lookups copy ids into VD_INSTANCE_ID_MAX buffers instead of returning strdup'd strings.

parts.name: Reconciler updates
parts.summary: prepareUpdate returns null unless a prop changed by value, and commitUpdate skips the native call when only handlers changed.

groups.title: Dirty flag and idle sleep
groups.why: The JS thread called `instance_tree_swap` every iteration with only `sched_yield` between ([#54](source:s1)).
groups.summary: Every `native*` instance call in `instance.c` sets the flag that `instance_tree_swap` now checks, and `js_runtime.c` sleeps through the new `vd_sleep_ms` when no input, timer, fetch or swap ran.
lookFor: Subtle: the mark sits at the top of each native function, before argument checks, so a rejected call still triggers one extra swap; it never skips one.
Perf: while busy the loop still calls `vd_thread_yield`, which on Vita is a 1 ms `sceKernelDelayThread`, as before.
Input queued while the thread sleeps waits at most `JS_IDLE_SLEEP_MAX_MS` (4 ms); timers wake on time because the sleep is clamped to `timeouts_next_due`.

groups.title: Cached package list and one manifest parse
groups.why: The Shell called `package_library_list` twice per frame, each doing `opendir`, a JSON parse and asset `stat`s, and fonts and images re-parsed the manifest ([#54](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `package_library_list` copies from a list that publish, remove and `package_library_refresh` (called when the Shell opens) invalidate, and `bootstrap.c` hands one parsed manifest to `font_registry_load_package` and `image_registry_load_package`; the new harness checks each invalidation.
lookFor: Subtle: set-active does not invalidate the cache; `is_active` is recomputed from `g_active_name` on every copy, so the flag is always current.
Packages copied in outside the library (FTP, manual copy) appear only after the Shell is reopened, which calls `package_library_refresh`.
The directory scan now runs under `g_mutex`, so a Shell frame that rescans can briefly block an upload publish, and the reverse.

groups.title: Caller buffers for hit and scroll ids
groups.why: `instance_hit_test` allocated a copy of the hit id every frame ([Máté's note](source:s2)).
groups.summary: `instance_hit_test`, `instance_scroll_at` and `instance_scroll_for_descendant` copy into a `VD_INSTANCE_ID_MAX` buffer under the snapshot lock, `input.c` passes stack buffers, and native create calls reject ids that would not fit.
lookFor: Breaking for oversize ids only: a create call with an id of 64+ characters now logs a warning and creates nothing; runtime ids are at most 52 characters.
Touch still `strdup`s the scroll id once per press into `touch_scroll_id`, which outlives the frame.

groups.title: prepareUpdate payload is used
groups.why: `prepareUpdate` computed a diff that `commitUpdate` discarded, so every parent re-render re-sent all props natively ([#54](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `diffProps` sets `native` when a non-handler, non-children prop changed by value and `handlers` when a handler identity changed, and `commitUpdate` runs only the work those flags name.
lookFor: Subtle: a parent passing `color={{ r: 1, g: 2, b: 3, a: 255 }}` inline used to trigger `nativeUpdateRect` every render; now two equal colors compare equal and no update is committed.
A new `onPress` closure each render now calls only `updateHandlers`, not the native update.
Native updates still send every prop: the `nativeUpdate*` functions in `src/jslib/instance.c` take full prop sets.

commits.subject: perf(runtime): skip native updates when no prop changed by value
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
prepareUpdate diffed props by identity and commitUpdate ignored the
result, so fresh color literals, handler closures and children re-sent
every prop natively on each parent render. The payload now says whether
a native prop changed (colors compare by value, children are ignored)
and whether only handlers changed, and commitUpdate does just that work.
The native update functions take full prop sets, so updates stay full
when they happen.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: perf(ui): copy hit and scroll ids into caller buffers
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
instance_hit_test strdup'd the hit id every frame, and the gamepad poll
did the same for the focused scroll container. They, and
instance_scroll_at, now copy into a VD_INSTANCE_ID_MAX buffer under the
snapshot lock, so the per-frame input path does no heap allocation.
Native create calls reject ids that would not fit, and input.c asserts
InputEvent.id holds every id. Raw text creation no longer leaks its text
when the id is missing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: perf(core): cache the installed package list
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The Shell listed packages twice per frame, each an opendir plus a
manifest parse and asset stat per package. package_library.c now keeps
the scanned list under its mutex, rescans after publish, remove, or an
explicit package_library_refresh (called when the Shell opens), and fills
is_active from the active name on every copy so set-active needs no
rescan. Bootstrap parses the active manifest once and hands it to the
font and image registries instead of each re-reading it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: perf(core): swap the instance tree only when dirty and sleep when idle
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The JS thread deep-copied the whole instance tree every loop iteration
with only sched_yield between, pinning a core. Native instance mutations
now mark the back buffer dirty and instance_tree_swap is a no-op
otherwise. When an iteration ran no input, timer, fetch or swap, the
thread sleeps until the next timer is due, capped at 4 ms, through a new
vd_sleep_ms in src/platform/.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
